notes: Static ancient broadleaf, approximately ten metres tall. Original trunk, hollow, roots and branch geometry retained. Crown envelopes reduced to 120 triangles each and forty folded leaves per cluster, preserving crown size and placement within the 28000-triangle budget. Front hollow has thick jambs, an inner back wall, ceiling and low sill. Deeply intersecting flared buttresses split into grounded surface roots; moss follows shaded basal furrows. No scenery.
